question_en: Which website should I use for course registration?
answer_en: You should use the GaesinNuri system (https://eis.cbnu.ac.kr/cbnuLogin).

question_en: What is the minimum grade required to earn credits in the undergraduate program?
answer_en: You must achieve a grade of D0 or higher to earn credits.
question_ko: 학부 과정에서 학점을 인정받으려면 최소 몇 등급을 받아야 하나요?
answer_ko: D0 등급 이상을 받아야 학점으로 인정됩니다.
question_zh: 本科课程要获得学分，最低需要多少等级？
answer_zh: 需要取得 D0 等级以上才会被承认学分。

question_en: How much attendance must a undergraduate student have to avoid receiving a F grade?
answer_en: Students must attend at least three-quarters (3/4) of the total class hours.
question_ko: 학부생이 F를 받지 않으려면 출석을 얼마나 해야 하나요?
question_zh: 本科生要避免 F，出勤率需要达到多少？
answer_zh: 必须出勤总课时的 4 分之 3 以上。

question_en: What GPA threshold results in academic warning (academic probation) for undergraduate students?
answer_en: If the semester GPA falls below 1.75, the student receives an academic warning.
question_ko: 학부생이 학사경고를 받는 평점 기준은 무엇인가요?
answer_ko: 매 학기 성적 평점평균이 1.75에 미달하면 학사경고를 받습니다.
question_zh: 本科生被学业警告的绩点标准是什么？
answer_zh: 如果每学期成绩平均绩点低于 1.75，就会受到学业警告。

question_en: What are the graduation language requirements for international undergraduate students?
answer_en: Students must meet TOPIK Level 4 or higher (or one of the approved English score requirements).
question_ko: 외국인 학부생의 졸업 어학 요건은 무엇인가요?
answer_ko: TOPIK 4급 이상(또는 영어 성적 요건 중 하나)을 충족해야 합니다.
question_zh: 外国人本科生的毕业语言要求是什么？
answer_zh: 需要达到 TOPIK 4 级以上（或符合其中一项英语成绩要求）。

question_en: Where should international students submit a leave of absence application?
answer_en: After consulting with the International Office staff in charge of international students, the application must be submitted to the department office.
answer_ko: 국제교류본부 유학생 담당자와 상담 후 학과 사무실에 제출해야 합니다.
question_zh: 休学申请应提交到哪里？
answer_zh: 需要与国际交流本部负责人咨询后，向所属学科办公室提交。

question_en: What GPA is required from the previous semester to be eligible for part-time work?
answer_en: As of the application date, the previous semester GPA must be at least 2.0 (grade C).
question_ko: 아르바이트(시간제 취업)를 하려면 직전 학기 성적이 얼마여야 하나요?
answer_ko: 신청일 기준 직전 학기 평균 성적이 2.0(C학점) 이상이어야 합니다.
question_zh: 打工（兼职）需要上学期成绩达到多少？
answer_zh: 以申请日为基准，前一学期平均成绩需要在 2.0（C 等级）以上。

question_en: How many hours can an undergraduate student (1st–2nd year) with TOPIK Level 3 work on weekdays?
answer_en: Up to 30 hours per week on weekdays, and unlimited hours on weekends and during vacations.
question_ko: TOPIK 3급인 학부생(1-2학년)은 주중에 몇 시간 일할 수 있나요?
question_zh: TOPIK 3级的本科 1-2年级学生，平日最多可工作多少小时？
answer_zh: 工作日每周最多可以工作 30 小时，周末和假期则没有上限。

question_en: Within how many days must I report a change of university?
answer_en: It must be reported within 15 days from the date the school was changed.
question_ko: 학교가 변경되었을 때 며칠 이내에 신고해야 하나요?
question_zh: 更换学校后几天内必须申报？
answer_zh: 需要在学校变更之日起 15 日以内申报。

question_en: Is private medical insurance mandatory besides National Health Insurance?
answer_en: It is strongly recommended to enroll in private insurance to prevent financial loss in case of a major accident.
question_ko: 국민건강보험 외에 민영보험도 꼭 가입해야 하나요?
answer_ko: 큰 사고 발생 시 경제적 손실을 방지하기 위해 가입을 강력히 권고합니다
question_zh: 除国民健康保险外，是否必须加入民间保险？
answer_zh: 为防止发生重大事故时的经济损失，强烈建议加入。
